change: display surface Storage keeps its buffers private and exposes values/known through accessors that first apply recorded writes in order; the bitmap stretch (StretchBlt of a loaded image into a surface) validates its rectangle at the call and records the pixel writes, applied at the surface's first pixel access; the recorded write captures the image value and decodes it then. Allocation stays at creation (calloc zero pages cost no physical memory until written), so allocation failures fall where they did
